transcript.zh_text: 我有28年的证据。

transcript.zh_text: 我可以诚实地说，即使我没嫁给他，他也肯定会得到我的票。

transcript.zh_text: 挪用联邦资金。

transcript.zh_text: 立法程序——差不多吧。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar, like any good lawyer, you have a knack for rhetoric-ish.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，像所有优秀的律师一样，你天生擅长花言巧语——或者说，有点那意思。

transcript.en_text: But the American people are tired of words.
transcript.zh_text: 但美国人民已经厌倦了空话。

transcript.zh_text: 他们渴望的是行动。

transcript.en_text: My concern about focusing on the word, "action," is that she'll just come back with failed actions.
transcript.zh_text: 我担心如果我们只强调“行动”这个词，她会拿出一堆失败的行动来反驳。

transcript.en_text: America Works, the UN mission.
transcript.zh_text: “美国行动”，联合国使命。

transcript.en_text: "Action" performed well with key demos in our last poll.
transcript.zh_text: “行动”这个词在我们上次民意调查中在主要人群中表现良好。

transcript.en_text: Yes, but doesn't this take us off message?
transcript.zh_text: 是的，但这不会让我们偏离主旨吗？

transcript.en_text: We have been saying, "A vote for Frank Underwood is a vote for America Works." That's what we've been running on.
transcript.zh_text: 我们一直在说，“投票给弗兰克·安德伍德就是投票给‘美国行动’。” 这就是我们一直以来的竞选主轴。

transcript.en_text: You need a word that goes beyond America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 你需要一个超越“美国行动”的词。

transcript.en_text: - Something that can be used for anything. - Remy, what do you think?
transcript.zh_text: - 一个可以用于任何事物的词。- 雷米，你觉得呢？

transcript.en_text: - Uh... - We're talking about the word, "action." Sorry, I was, uh...
transcript.zh_text: - 呃…… - 我们在谈论“行动”这个词。抱歉，我刚才在……

transcript.en_text: My mind was on the foreign policy argument.
transcript.zh_text: 我的思绪都在外交政策的争论上。

transcript.en_text: - I was just thinking ahead. - What about "vision"?
transcript.zh_text: - 我只是在想下一步。 - 那“愿景”怎么样？

transcript.en_text: Isn't that too generic?
transcript.zh_text: 这会不会太笼统了？

transcript.zh_text: 这就是我们想要的。

transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，越笼统越好。

transcript.en_text: People can project anything they want on "vision." I'll get it polled before tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 人们可以把自己想要的任何东西投射到“愿景”上。我会在明天之前把它付诸投票。

transcript.en_text: We should work on Sharp next.
transcript.zh_text: 接下来我们应该争取夏普。

transcript.zh_text: 你想让我扮演她吗？

transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你如此认真地对待你的角色，唐纳德。

transcript.zh_text: 你应该考虑从事舞台表演事业。

transcript.zh_text: 因为他肯定不会是我的竞选搭档。

transcript.en_text: You're good at this.
transcript.zh_text: 你很擅长这个。

transcript.en_text: They loved you.
transcript.zh_text: 他们很喜欢你。

transcript.en_text: Three decades of campaigns, you learn how to read an audience.
transcript.zh_text: 三十年的竞选生涯，你会学到如何洞察观众。

transcript.en_text: Self-promotion gives me hives.
transcript.zh_text: 自我推销让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

transcript.en_text: Honestly, I don't know how you do it.
transcript.zh_text: 老实说，我不知道你是怎么做到的。

transcript.en_text: I'm promoting my husband, not myself.
transcript.zh_text: 我在宣传我丈夫，不是我自己。

transcript.en_text: That's a convenient way to spin it, don't you think?
transcript.zh_text: 这是一种很方便的说法，你不觉得吗？

transcript.en_text: Are you always this blunt?
transcript.zh_text: 你总是这么直言不讳吗？

transcript.zh_text: 我只有两天时间可以跟着。

transcript.zh_text: 介意我搭你的车吗，既然我们时间这么少？

transcript.zh_text: 我需要打些电话。

transcript.zh_text: 也许我们以后会找到一些时间。

transcript.zh_text: 雷米，你刚才心不在焉的。

transcript.zh_text: 怎么回事？

transcript.zh_text: 没什么。

transcript.en_text: Everything's good.
transcript.zh_text: 一切都好。

transcript.en_text: I need you on your A-game, Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 雷米，我需要你发挥出最佳状态。

transcript.en_text: This debate could make us the front-runner.
transcript.zh_text: 这场辩论能让我们成为领跑者。

transcript.en_text: It's just between the campaign and managing the White House, - I'm a little burnt out. - We still have months to go.
transcript.zh_text: 光是竞选和管理白宫，我就有点筋疲力尽了。- 我们还有几个月呢。

transcript.zh_text: - 大选前还有一年。- 这只是暂时的。

transcript.en_text: I'll get past it.
transcript.zh_text: 我会挺过去的。

transcript.zh_text: 如果你能做到，我也能。

transcript.zh_text: 加文？

transcript.zh_text: - 你好，道格拉斯。- 你想干什么？

transcript.zh_text: 你还是不相信她死了，是吗？

transcript.zh_text: 你确实不该相信，因为她没死。

transcript.zh_text: 她还活着，而且我确切知道她在哪里。

transcript.zh_text: - 她尸体的照片。- 那不是她。

transcript.zh_text: 我伪造了这一切，好让你解除我护照的锁定。

transcript.zh_text: 好吧，道格，我现在已经脱身了。

transcript.zh_text: 而且我很安全。

transcript.zh_text: 但我朋友不是。

transcript.zh_text: 跟格林谈谈。

transcript.zh_text: 给他我得到的同样待遇，所有指控都撤销。

transcript.en_text: You do that, and I'll tell you where she is.

transcript.en_text: Ah!

transcript.zh_text: 但那正是人们在辩论中想要的。

transcript.zh_text: 我对强势没有意见。

transcript.en_text: Welcome to the first Democratic nomination debate hosted by CNN.
transcript.zh_text: 欢迎收看由CNN主办的首场民主党提名辩论。

transcript.en_text: Our candidates tonight: Frank Underwood, Jackie Sharp, and Heather Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 今晚的候选人有：弗兰克·安德伍德、杰基·夏普和海瑟·邓巴。

transcript.en_text: I'm John King and I'll be your moderator tonight.
transcript.zh_text: 我是约翰·金，今晚的辩论主持人。

transcript.en_text: Our debate will be divided in two parts, the first part focusing on foreign policy, part two focusing on the domestic agenda.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的辩论将分为两部分，第一部分侧重外交政策，第二部分侧重国内议程。

transcript.en_text: And our format will be as follows: I will ask one candidate a question.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的形式如下：我将向一位候选人提问。

transcript.en_text: That candidate will have one minute to answer.

transcript.en_text: This nomination comes down to one word: vision.
transcript.zh_text: 这次提名归结为一句话：愿景。

transcript.en_text: I believe that I have shown a clear vision to this country with America Works, the most comprehensive jobs program in nearly a century.

transcript.en_text: We showed it could work in Washington DC.
transcript.zh_text: 我们证明了它在华盛顿特区是可行的。

transcript.en_text: We need now to take what we did there and spread it nationwide, so that the American dream can become the American reality.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在需要将我们在那里所做的一切推广到全国，这样美国梦才能成为美国的现实。

transcript.en_text: But that vision isn't enough on its own.
transcript.zh_text: 但仅仅有愿景还不够。

transcript.en_text: You need someone with experience to make it happen.
transcript.zh_text: 你需要有经验的人才能实现它。

transcript.en_text: And between my time in Congress and now at the White House, I have more experience than both of my opponents combined.
transcript.zh_text: 我在国会任职期间以及现在在白宫的经历，让我比我的两位对手加起来都更有经验。

transcript.zh_text: 那真是非凡的。

transcript.en_text: But out in the general workforce?
transcript.zh_text: 但对于普通劳动力市场呢？

transcript.en_text: Women earn 77 cents on the dollar compared to men.
transcript.zh_text: 女性每挣一美元，只相当于男性挣的77美分。

highlights.zh_word: 每挣一美元，只相当于77美分

transcript.en_text: Even worse is minority women earning 67 cents on the dollar.
transcript.zh_text: 更糟糕的是，少数族裔女性每挣一美元，只相当于67美分。

highlights.zh_word: 每挣一美元，只相当于67美分

transcript.en_text: Now, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，

transcript.en_text: Dunbar can talk about balancing the scales, but she inherited a multi-billion-dollar fortune and never had to earn any cents on the dollar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士可以谈论平衡天平，但她继承了数十亿美元的财富，从未需要像普通人那样辛苦挣钱。

transcript.en_text: Now, I don't agree with everything that President Underwood has done or proposes, but at least he knows what it means to work for a living.
transcript.zh_text: 我不完全同意安德伍德总统所做或提议的一切，但至少他知道为了生计而工作意味着什么。

transcript.en_text: I can give you even better than that.
transcript.zh_text: 我能给你更好的。

transcript.en_text: I know what it means to fight for a living.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道为了生存而奋斗意味着什么。

transcript.en_text: And I will fight for fairness here at home just as fiercely as I fought our enemies overseas.
transcript.zh_text: 我会像在海外与敌人作战一样，在国内为公平而战，不惜一切。

transcript.en_text: Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，女众议员。

transcript.en_text: Let's move to part one: foreign policy.
transcript.zh_text: 让我们进入第一部分：外交政策。

transcript.en_text: And the first question is for you, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 第一个问题是给您，

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Given the recent volatile events in the Jordan Valley, do you still believe it was correct to assemble the United Nations coalition and to intervene, or is it time now to call that intervention a mistake?
transcript.zh_text: 鉴于最近约旦河谷的动荡事件，您是否仍然认为组建联合国联盟并进行干预是正确的，还是现在是时候承认那次干预是一个错误了？

transcript.en_text: Well, I will answer that question, John, but I'd like to address first something Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，约翰，我会回答这个问题，但我想先谈谈邓巴女士刚才说的一些事。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar said a few moments ago.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士刚才说的一些事。

transcript.en_text: America Works is not some stale, old, conservative agenda.
transcript.zh_text: “美国工作”计划并非一些陈旧的、保守的议程。

transcript.en_text: You name me one Republican who has suggested using federal funds to guarantee jobs for every American who wants one and I will eat my hat.
transcript.zh_text: 你给我指出一位共和党人，他曾建议动用联邦资金来为每个想工作的美国人保障就业，如果真有，我愿吞下我的帽子。

transcript.en_text: This isn't about dismantling government.
transcript.zh_text: 这无关解散政府。

transcript.en_text: It is about-- Aren't we supposed to be talking about foreign policy?
transcript.zh_text: 这是关于——难道我们不应该谈论外交政策吗？

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I will.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我会的。

transcript.en_text: But first, I'd like to correct-- Because it's easier to talk about America Works than to defend your indefensible UN mission.
transcript.zh_text: 但首先，我想纠正——因为谈论“美国工程”比为你们站不住脚的联合国任务辩护更容易。

transcript.en_text: At least I have a record to defend, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 至少我有一份可以捍卫的履历，邓巴女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴。

transcript.en_text: Speaking of your record, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 说到您的履历，总统先生，

transcript.en_text: President, you went on record saying you wouldn't run for president.
transcript.zh_text: 您曾公开声明不会竞选总统。

transcript.en_text: - And yet here you are. - John, it seems that your very thoughtful rules have gone out the window.
transcript.zh_text: ——然而您现在却在这里。——约翰，看来你那些考虑周全的规矩都被抛到九霄云外了。

transcript.en_text: You have no respect for rules, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 你对规矩毫无敬意，

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Take FEMA, for example.
transcript.zh_text: 就拿联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）来说吧。

transcript.en_text: Oh, you want to talk about FEMA now instead of foreign policy.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，你现在想谈联邦紧急事务管理局，而不是外交政策了。

transcript.en_text: I am just following your lead, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 我只是跟着您的领导，先生。

transcript.en_text: See what a mess we get into when we follow your brand of leadership?
transcript.zh_text: 看看我们跟着您这种领导方式会陷入怎样的困境？

highlights.en_word: what a mess we get into
highlights.zh_word: 我们会陷入怎样的困境

transcript.en_text: Well, I must admit that Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我必须承认，邓巴女士

transcript.en_text: Dunbar does have many years of experience making rhetorical arguments in court.
transcript.zh_text: 确实有多年在法庭上进行雄辩的经验。

transcript.en_text: You've just seen proof of that today.
transcript.zh_text: 今天你们已经看到了证据。

transcript.en_text: But serving the American people is not about what you say, it's about what you do.
transcript.zh_text: 但服务美国人民，不是看你说了什么，而是看你做了什么。

transcript.en_text: And I would ask: what have you ever done?
transcript.zh_text: 我想问：你到底做过什么？

transcript.en_text: I have to agree that Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 我不得不承认，

transcript.en_text: Dunbar's lack of experience is a concern.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士缺乏经验确实令人担忧。

transcript.en_text: I find it ironic that the president talks about the importance of experience, given the fact that he appointed his wife UN ambassador - despite her utter lack of credentials. - That's a sexist comment.
transcript.zh_text: 我发现这很讽刺，总统谈论经验的重要性，鉴于他任命他的妻子为联合国大使——尽管她完全缺乏资历。—— 这是性别歧视的言论。

transcript.en_text: Excuse me?
transcript.zh_text: 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: You wouldn't be making that argument if a female president had appointed her husband.
transcript.zh_text: 如果一位女总统任命她的丈夫，你就不会提出这种论点了。

transcript.en_text: A husband with the same lack of international affairs experience as Claire Underwood?
transcript.zh_text: 一个和克莱尔·安德伍德一样缺乏国际事务经验的丈夫吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I would.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我会。

transcript.en_text: In fact, it makes me question your advocacy for women in general.
transcript.zh_text: 事实上，这让我质疑你对女性的普遍倡导。

transcript.en_text: Well, that's ridiculous.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，那太荒谬了。

transcript.en_text: What have you done to further gender equality?
transcript.zh_text: 你为促进性别平等做了什么？

transcript.en_text: What have you done to balance the scales?
transcript.zh_text: 你为平衡局面做了什么？

transcript.en_text: That's your slogan, and yet you've left half of the population out of the mix.
transcript.zh_text: 那是你的口号，然而你却把一半的人口排除在外。

transcript.en_text: But that is simply not true.
transcript.zh_text: 但这根本不是真的。

transcript.en_text: Can, can you name one specific thing?
transcript.zh_text: 你，你能说出一件具体的事情吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I can.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我可以。

transcript.en_text: Being a woman, who has served as Solicitor General, one of the few in the history of the court.
transcript.zh_text: 作为一名女性，曾担任副总检察长，是法院历史上少数几位之一。

transcript.en_text: Well, that advanced your interests, but what did that do for 150 million women out there?
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，那促进了你的利益，但那对那里的1.5亿女性做了什么呢？

transcript.en_text: The very fact that a woman can hold that position-- - So you are a symbol. - In a way, yes, I suppose I am.
transcript.zh_text: 一个女人能担任那个职位的事实本身—— —所以你是一个象征。—从某种程度上说，是的，我想我是。

transcript.en_text: Me and many other women, including yourself-- Okay, but how does that get us from 77 cents on the dollar to 100?
transcript.zh_text: 我和许多其他女性，包括你自己—— 好吧，但这如何能让我们从每美元77美分提高到100美分呢？

transcript.en_text: Real cents.
transcript.zh_text: 实实在在的钱。

transcript.en_text: Not symbolic cents.
transcript.zh_text: 这不是象征性的几分钱。

transcript.en_text: Well, now you're just aping the president's rhetoric.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，你现在只是在模仿总统的言论。

transcript.en_text: Another sexist comment.
transcript.zh_text: 又是一个性别歧视的评论。

transcript.en_text: How could you possibly misconstrue my words?
transcript.zh_text: 你怎么可能曲解我的话？

transcript.en_text: I speak for myself.
transcript.zh_text: 我只代表我自己。

transcript.en_text: I am not aping the president or any other man.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有模仿总统或其他任何人。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, I won't engage with this-- You know, when things get tough on the battlefield, we never say, "Sorry, I won't engage." We engage, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，我不会处理这个——你知道，当战场局势艰难时，我们从不说“抱歉，我不会参与。”我们就是要参与，邓巴女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴。

transcript.en_text: And you need to confront the fact that you do not have women's best interests at heart.
transcript.zh_text: 你需要正视这个事实，那就是你并没有真正为女性的最佳利益着想。

transcript.en_text: John, this is getting out of hand.
transcript.zh_text: 约翰，这事情要失控了。

transcript.en_text: All right, then let's move on to the next question.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，那我们继续下一个问题。

transcript.en_text: We are in the foreign policy portion of this debate.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在正处于这场辩论的外交政策部分。

transcript.en_text: Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar, let me bring this question to you.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，让我把这个问题提给你。

transcript.en_text: You're critical of the president.
transcript.zh_text: 你对总统持批评态度。

transcript.en_text: You say it's indefensible, what he has done in the Jordan Valley.
transcript.zh_text: 你说他在约旦河谷所做的一切是无法辩护的。

transcript.en_text: But specifically, what would you do differently?
transcript.zh_text: 但具体来说，你会采取什么不同的做法？

transcript.en_text: Well, John, I'm glad you asked that.
transcript.zh_text: 约翰，很高兴你问了这个问题。

transcript.en_text: Sending troops into the Jordan Valley...
transcript.zh_text: 派兵进入约旦河谷……

transcript.en_text: - I need to go back to the hotel. - ...isn't what I call diplomacy.
transcript.zh_text: - 我需要回酒店。 - ……那可不是我所说的外交。

transcript.en_text: Everybody, Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 各位，安德伍德夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood needs to leave us now.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人现在需要离开了。

transcript.en_text: I really wish I could stay, but I have a very full day tomorrow.
transcript.zh_text: 我真希望我能留下来，但我明天行程排得很满。

transcript.en_text: I should rest up.
transcript.zh_text: 我应该休息一下了。

transcript.en_text: But again, I want to thank you all for your hospitality and all of your hard work.
transcript.zh_text: 但我再次感谢大家的盛情款待和辛勤付出。

transcript.en_text: Thank you so much.
transcript.zh_text: 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: Good night, everyone.
transcript.zh_text: 各位晚安。

transcript.en_text: His trickle-down diplomacy is another example of delusion.
transcript.zh_text: 他的涓滴外交是另一种妄想。

transcript.en_text: Mrs.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德夫人。

transcript.en_text: Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德。

transcript.en_text: Oh, you should go back inside with the volunteers and have the full campaign experience.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，你应该和志愿者们一起回去，体验完整的竞选活动。

transcript.en_text: I didn't come to New Hampshire for that.
transcript.zh_text: 我来新罕布什尔州不是为了那个。

transcript.en_text: I came to speak with you.
transcript.zh_text: 我是来跟你谈话的。

transcript.en_text: Tomorrow, maybe.
transcript.zh_text: 明天再说吧。

transcript.en_text: My brain is a bit fried.
transcript.zh_text: 我的脑子有点累坏了。

transcript.en_text: Is it what Sharp said?
transcript.zh_text: 是夏普说的那些话吗？

transcript.en_text: Why you don't want to watch anymore?
transcript.zh_text: 你为什么不想再看下去了？

transcript.en_text: - The sexist comment? - Oh, I honestly don't care.
transcript.zh_text: - 那个性别歧视的评论吗？ - 哦，我真的不在乎。

transcript.en_text: It's all spectacle.
transcript.zh_text: 这都是作秀。

transcript.en_text: Who can get the most points, right?
transcript.zh_text: 谁能得分最多，对吧？

transcript.en_text: Good night.
transcript.zh_text: 晚安。

transcript.en_text: Now for part two of our debate: the domestic agenda.
transcript.zh_text: 现在进入我们辩论的第二部分：国内议程。

transcript.en_text: And the first question goes to you, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 第一个问题提给您，女议员。

transcript.en_text: The President speaks of America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 总统谈到了“美国就业计划”。

transcript.en_text: Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar wants to raise minimum wage.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士想提高最低工资。

transcript.en_text: Talks about regulating executive pay.
transcript.zh_text: 她谈论管制高管薪酬。

transcript.en_text: But a lot of people aren't quite clear about your economic policy.
transcript.zh_text: 但很多人对您的经济政策还不太清楚。

transcript.en_text: What specifically, I underscore "specifically," would you do if elected president?
transcript.zh_text: 具体来说，我强调“具体来说”，如果您当选总统，您会怎么做？

transcript.en_text: Well, I plan to do a lot.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我计划做很多事情。

transcript.en_text: And we talked about this earlier.
transcript.zh_text: 我们之前已经讨论过这个问题了。

transcript.en_text: First and foremost, I want to press for gender equality and close the salary gap.
transcript.zh_text: 首先，我希望推动性别平等，缩小薪资差距。

transcript.en_text: If half of the working population has more money in their pockets, that will catalyze spending, which will grow the economy, which will, in turn, create more jobs.
transcript.zh_text: 如果一半的劳动人口口袋里有更多钱，这将刺激消费，从而促进经济增长，进而创造更多就业机会。

transcript.en_text: Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 总统先生，

transcript.en_text: President, what do you think of that?
transcript.zh_text: 您对此有何看法？

transcript.en_text: Oh, I agree.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我同意。

transcript.en_text: I think that gender equality is very important.
transcript.zh_text: 我认为性别平等非常重要。

transcript.en_text: And under my AmWorks program, there will be a provision that all AmWorks jobs, there can be no discrepancy in pay between men and women.
transcript.zh_text: 根据我的“美国就业计划”，将有一项规定，所有“美国就业计划”的职位，男女之间不得存在薪酬差异。

transcript.en_text: AmWorks jobs, that's the government.
transcript.zh_text: “美国就业计划”的职位是政府提供的。

transcript.en_text: What about the rest of the private sector?
transcript.zh_text: 那私营部门的其他部分呢？

transcript.en_text: We have to start by leading by example, then we introduce-- Leading by example?
transcript.zh_text: 我们必须以身作则，然后我们介绍——以身作则？

transcript.en_text: If America Works is how you lead by example...
transcript.zh_text: 如果“美国工程”是你以身作则的方式...

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, please let me finish my point.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，请让我把话说完。

transcript.en_text: If that is how you lead by example, then are we to assume that everyone should illegally raid funds that they have no right to use?
transcript.zh_text: 如果这就是你以身作则的方式，那我们是否应该认为每个人都可以非法侵吞他们无权使用的资金？

transcript.en_text: Everyone should start robbing banks?
transcript.zh_text: 每个人都应该开始抢银行吗？

transcript.en_text: Holding up liquor stores?
transcript.zh_text: 抢劫酒类商店？

transcript.en_text: Now, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，

transcript.en_text: Dunbar, with all due respect, you can criticize my programs as much as you want, but to accuse me of illegal activity-- One thing you can't deny is that I am much more of an authority on the Constitution than you are, Mr.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，恕我直言，你可以随意批评我的项目，但指控我从事非法活动——你无法否认的一点是，在宪法方面，我比你更有权威，先生。

transcript.en_text: President.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，

transcript.en_text: Dunbar, all three of us on this stage have taken oaths of office.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，我们台上三个人都宣誓就职了。

transcript.en_text: I would have to say that we have all defended the Constitution.
transcript.zh_text: 我不得不说我们都捍卫了宪法。

transcript.en_text: You don't have some special claim on the Constitution.
transcript.zh_text: 你对宪法没有特别的主张。

transcript.en_text: The Constitution belongs to everyone in this room and every citizen in the United States.
transcript.zh_text: 宪法属于这个房间里的每个人以及美国的每一位公民。

transcript.en_text: But I would ask Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 但我想问夏普女士，

transcript.en_text: Sharp, you voted in favor of dismantling America Works.
transcript.zh_text: 夏普，你投票赞成废除“美国工程”。

transcript.en_text: Was that because you thought it was in fact, as Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 那是因为你认为它实际上，正如邓巴女士所说，是非法的吗？

transcript.en_text: Dunbar says, illegal?
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士所说，是非法的吗？

transcript.en_text: I voted for dismantlement because I wanted to make sure we were prepared for the hurricane, not because I thought your reading of the Stafford Act was illegal per se.
transcript.zh_text: 我投票支持废除，是因为我想确保我们为飓风做好了准备，而不是因为我认为你对《斯塔福德法案》的解读本身是非法的。

transcript.en_text: Honestly, you think the president had a right to do what he did?
transcript.zh_text: 老实说，你认为总统有权做他所做的事情吗？

transcript.en_text: It's an appropriations issue, not a legal one.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个拨款问题，而不是一个法律问题。

transcript.en_text: What about his character?
transcript.zh_text: 他的品格如何？

transcript.en_text: He basically walked into FEMA and said, "Stick 'em up and show me where the vault is." So now I'm a bank robber.
transcript.zh_text: 他基本上走进联邦应急管理局，说：“举起手来，告诉我金库在哪儿。”所以现在我是个银行劫匪了。

transcript.en_text: Six Gun Underwood, what they call me in South Carolina.
transcript.zh_text: 六枪安德伍德，他们在南卡罗来纳州这样叫我。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, but I do not find this funny.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，但我一点也不觉得这好笑。

transcript.en_text: I say you are a hypocrite.
transcript.zh_text: 我说你是个伪君子。

transcript.en_text: You claim to care about the ten million people out of work, but you will steal their disaster relief fund...
transcript.zh_text: 你声称关心那千万失业人口，但你却要偷走他们的灾难救济基金……

transcript.en_text: - This is an appropriations issue. - ...Social Security and health care.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是一个拨款问题。- ……社会保障和医疗保健。

transcript.en_text: We put 50,000 people to work in Washington DC.
transcript.zh_text: 我们在华盛顿特区为五万人提供了工作。

transcript.en_text: Heather Dunbar wants to balance the scales to fix a broken system.
transcript.zh_text: 海瑟·邓巴想平衡各方，以修复一个破损的系统。

transcript.en_text: And yet she sends her own kids to private school.
transcript.zh_text: 然而她却把自己的孩子送去私立学校。

transcript.en_text: With money she never earned, but which she inherited.
transcript.zh_text: 用的是她从未赚取，却继承来的钱。

transcript.en_text: Now, it is easy to talk about the problems of the poor with a silver spoon in your mouth.
transcript.zh_text: 嘴含银勺子谈论穷人的问题，这可太容易了。

highlights.en_word: a silver spoon in your mouth

transcript.en_text: Am I well-off?
transcript.zh_text: 我家境富裕吗？

transcript.en_text: Absolutely.
transcript.zh_text: 当然。

transcript.en_text: So was FDR when he developed the New Deal.
transcript.zh_text: 罗斯福总统在推行新政时也是如此。

transcript.en_text: Since when does one's income determine one's amount of empathy?
transcript.zh_text: 从什么时候开始，一个人的收入能决定其同情心的多少了？

transcript.en_text: Would you send your kids to public school?
transcript.zh_text: 你会把你的孩子送去公立学校吗？

transcript.en_text: Let's keep our children out of this.
transcript.zh_text: 别把我们的孩子牵扯进来。

transcript.en_text: You want your kids to have a head start, to have an advantage over the kids in public schools.
transcript.zh_text: 你想让你的孩子有一个领先优势，比公立学校的孩子更有优势。

transcript.en_text: Lots of Americans, of all ranges of income, choose to send their children to private or parochial schools.
transcript.zh_text: 许多美国人，无论收入高低，都选择把孩子送往私立学校或教会学校。

transcript.en_text: But isn't it true that you want your children to have a leg up on everyone else?
transcript.zh_text: 但难道不是您希望自己的孩子比别人更有优势吗？

transcript.en_text: Is that balancing the scales?
transcript.zh_text: 这是在平衡局势吗？

transcript.en_text: Or is that hypocrisy?
transcript.zh_text: 还是伪善？

transcript.en_text: Or maybe it's that you didn't want to raise them yourself so you sent them to boarding school.
transcript.zh_text: 又或许是您不想亲自抚养他们，所以把他们送去了寄宿学校。

transcript.en_text: Wow.
transcript.zh_text: 哇。

transcript.en_text: You must really want to be president.
transcript.zh_text: 您一定很想当总统。

transcript.en_text: I would never in a million years bring up your children in a debate.
transcript.zh_text: 我绝不会在辩论中提及您的孩子。

transcript.en_text: The way you choose to raise them is your business.
transcript.zh_text: 您选择抚养他们的方式是您的私事。

transcript.en_text: Do I want the best for my kids?
transcript.zh_text: 我希望我的孩子有最好的发展吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I do.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我希望。

transcript.en_text: I imagine you're the same way.
transcript.zh_text: 我想您也是一样。

transcript.en_text: I hope you are.
transcript.zh_text: 我希望您是。

transcript.en_text: Well, I'm sure you're both excellent mothers.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我确信你们两位都是优秀的母亲。

transcript.en_text: But perhaps we should get back to some-- Congresswoman Sharp raised the issue of sexism earlier.
transcript.zh_text: 但或许我们应该回到——夏普女议员早些时候提到了性别歧视的问题。

transcript.en_text: Now, it is an important point, and we need to address it.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个重要的问题，我们需要解决它。

transcript.en_text: Sexism is wrong.
transcript.zh_text: 性别歧视是错误的。

transcript.en_text: The Congresswoman is correct in saying that all aspects of it should be illegal.
transcript.zh_text: 女议员说它的所有方面都应该是非法的，这是正确的。

transcript.en_text: And then, she accused me of being sexist for criticizing Claire Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 然后，她指责我批评克莱尔·安德伍德是性别歧视。

transcript.en_text: But wouldn't that same logic hold true for you, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 但同样的逻辑对您来说不也适用吗，女士？

transcript.en_text: Sharp?
transcript.zh_text: 尖刻吗？

transcript.en_text: Would you have come after my kids if I were a man?
transcript.zh_text: 如果我是个男人，你会来找我孩子的麻烦吗？

transcript.en_text: Aren't you trying to paint the picture that I'm a bad mother, shipping my kids off to some far-flung place?
transcript.zh_text: 你不是正试图把我描绘成一个坏母亲，把我孩子送到某个遥远的地方吗？

transcript.en_text: Because you know if you can make me seem like a bad mother, then how could anyone possibly support me?
transcript.zh_text: 因为你知道，如果你能让我看起来像个坏母亲，那么谁还会支持我呢？

transcript.en_text: That's not hardball, that is just disgusting.
transcript.zh_text: 那不是强硬手段，那简直是恶心。

transcript.en_text: Well, I have to say I do think Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我不得不说，我确实认为女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar has a point.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴说得有道理。

transcript.en_text: I mean, speaking of hypocrisy, don't you send your own kids to private school, Congresswoman?
transcript.zh_text: 我是说，说到虚伪，你不是也把自己的孩子送去私立学校吗，女议员？

transcript.en_text: - Well, that wasn't my point.
transcript.zh_text: - 嗯，那不是我的重点。

transcript.en_text: I-- - What was your point?
transcript.zh_text: 我—— - 你的重点是什么？

transcript.en_text: Well, I was, um...
My...
My point....

transcript.en_text: Um...
John, I think I've said all I need to say on this subject.
transcript.zh_text: 约翰，我想关于这个话题我该说的都说了。

transcript.en_text: All right, fair enough, Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，够公平了，女议员。

transcript.en_text: Next question goes to you, Ms.
transcript.zh_text: 下一个问题由您回答，女士。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴。

transcript.en_text: Okay, guys, first poll is coming in.
transcript.zh_text: 好的，各位，第一批民意调查结果出来了。

transcript.en_text: Most of them give Frank Underwood the win.
transcript.zh_text: 他们中的大多数都认为弗兰克·安德伍德赢了。

transcript.en_text: Not by a lot.
transcript.zh_text: 差不了多少。

transcript.en_text: But did he do enough to overtake Dunbar, become the front-runner?
transcript.zh_text: 但他所做的是否足以超越邓巴，成为领跑者呢？

transcript.en_text: George, I don't think it's so much what Underwood did, but what he didn't do.
transcript.zh_text: 乔治，我认为重要的不是安德伍德做了什么，而是他没做什么。

transcript.en_text: He remained presidential.
transcript.zh_text: 他保持了总统风范。

transcript.en_text: And when the attacks came his way, he held the high ground.
transcript.zh_text: 当攻击向他袭来时，他坚守了道德高地。

transcript.en_text: Now, Dunbar and Sharp, they came out swinging, and I think it hurt them both.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴和夏普则火力全开，我认为这让他们俩都受了伤。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, but Sharp had to do something.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，但夏普不得不做点什么。

transcript.en_text: She's 20 points behind the other two.
transcript.zh_text: 她落后另外两人20个百分点。

transcript.en_text: But the sexism thing?
transcript.zh_text: 但关于性别歧视的问题呢？

transcript.en_text: And going after Dunbar's kids?
transcript.zh_text: 还有攻击邓巴的孩子？

transcript.en_text: - It seemed quite desperate. - She did do some damage to Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: - 这看起来很绝望。 - 她的确对邓巴造成了一些伤害。

transcript.en_text: I don't know about that.
transcript.zh_text: 我可不这么认为。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar could've fared far worse.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴的情况本可能糟糕得多。

transcript.en_text: She took it on the chin, held her own, and in my opinion, it was a tie.
transcript.zh_text: 她挺住了攻击，坚持住了自己的立场，依我看来，结果是平局。

transcript.en_text: But bottom line, does this debate change anything?
transcript.zh_text: 但归根结底，这场辩论会改变什么吗？

transcript.en_text: Does it affect the caucus, does it affect the primary in New Hampshire?
transcript.zh_text: 它会影响党团会议吗？会影响新罕布什尔州的初选吗？

transcript.en_text: We're still over a month out.
transcript.zh_text: 我们离投票还有一个月多。

transcript.en_text: And so a lot could change in this process, but I do think the momentum could shift in Underwood's favor.
transcript.zh_text: 因此，在这个过程中很多事情都可能改变，但我确实认为势头可能会转向安德伍德一边。

transcript.en_text: Let's not forget that it's remarkable that a sitting president isn't considered the front-runner to begin with.
transcript.zh_text: 别忘了，一位在任总统最初不被视为领跑者，这本身就很了不起。

transcript.en_text: That's an excellent point.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个很好的观点。

transcript.en_text: No incumbent has ever had to fight back from this far--
transcript.zh_text: 没有任何现任者曾从如此不利的局面中反击成功。

transcript.zh_text: 你知道，这并非我们所期望的本垒打，但你表现得很棒，杰基。
